## Description
Summary of the changes made and the problem being solved.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing code/contracts to change)
- [ ] Smart contract enhancement (`soroban-contracts/royalty-vault`)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Affected Components
- [ ] `soroban-contracts/royalty-vault`
- [ ] `apps/frontend`
- [ ] `apps/backend-api`
- [ ] `apps/oracle-worker`
- [ ] `packages/stellar-sdk`
- [ ] `packages/types`
- [ ] `packages/ui`

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project style guidelines (`cargo fmt`, ESLint/Prettier).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have added/updated tests covering my changes.
- [ ] All Rust unit tests pass (`cargo test`).
- [ ] Full monorepo build succeeds (`pnpm turbo run build`).
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly.
